title: Implement position privacy auth modes and consume position_privacy_auth.json
description: test/vectors/position_privacy_auth.json (public/group/private modes per spec 18.1) unconsumed; no mode-based auth found in python/src/lichen/coap/resources/position.py. Implement modes + pytest consumer.
close_reason: Position privacy auth oracle shipped: lichen/coap/position_privacy.py (PositionPrivacyMode + PositionPrivacyPolicy). Semantics per vectors: public accepts any reader; group requires OSCORE (4.01 without) and group context/membership (4.03 for authenticated non-members); private requires pairwise OSCORE from the exact allowed peer (4.01/4.03 otherwise); mode changes take effect immediately; beacons include position only in public mode. 12 pytest cases consume every vector incl. mode-switch-immediacy and beacon-inclusion table. Standalone decision module - wiring into the live position resources deferred to the senml/resources lane owner (files under active edit).
